takes.situation: Mid-service with hot plates: he hands her a stamped card in her name, and she asks what she owes.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I've got plates. Why's that card in my name?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Look at the stamp. We've paid part of your Bureau loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know you. Who's been asking about me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody who'll trouble you. Put it away, the terrace can see.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Table four's waiting. What do I owe you for this?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing tonight. There's a small favour, later, once the rest is paid.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll keep it. But I can't do anything for you, not yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then we'll wait. I'll be back with the rest.

learned: Inez took it; not ready yet.

takes.situation: She thinks a tube slip is a Bureau error and threatens to return it; she has the last word.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You've read that slip three times. It's no mistake.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know you. How do you know what that says?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We paid it. Part of your Bureau loan, this evening.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's been asking about me? I'll send it back up the tube.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Send it back and you owe the lot again. Why do that?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Because nobody pays for nothing. What would I have to do?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: A small favour, nothing that hurts anyone. I'll bring the rest first.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Bring it, then. I'll keep this, but I can't do anything yet.

learned: Inez took it; not ready yet.

takes.situation: She tries to repay him from her tips, then says yes too fast and takes it back.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Here, tonight's tips. I'll pay you back a little every week.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep your tips. We paid part of your Bureau loan, and gladly.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The Bureau's collector said 'Balance reduced, madam.' I don't know you people.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No, but we know you. Late shifts, one bad loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's been asking? Was it somebody on my terrace?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Never mind who. There'll be a small favour, later on.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Thank you, yes, whatever it is. No, wait, I can't, not yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Say yes when you mean it. I'll be back with the rest.

learned: Inez took it; not ready yet.
